_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $25.0B bookings in FY10; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2009 10-K names off-shore providers, 'particularly Indian providers ... often at highly competitive prices', among its competitors and says it is 'experiencing pricing pressures from some clients' and has 'shifted to lower-cost resources at reduced price levels', while its own Global Delivery Network stood at 81,000+ people. The stock trades at 15.1x FY11E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with $25.0B bookings in FY10; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.30x; +26% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.85; conservative 2yr +28%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +13.4%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +14.2%/yr (FY03-FY10 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY10); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2010-10-08) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.30x (17.0% downside to Bear $38 / +57.3% upside to Bull $72) | Adj composite 2.83 vs market 1.98: gap +0.85 [UNDERVALUED] | +25% above the EPP floor $36 (12x FY11E $3.04) | Conservative 2-yr case: +27.7% total (+13.9%/yr) | At 15.1x FY11E the 15% hurdle price $61 sits at or below the BASE case; consulting +9% LC in Q4, FY11 guided +7-10% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
